text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting double-digit losses over the day, with Ethereum underperforming Bitcoin by about 2 percentage points, suggesting renewed weakness in altcoin appetite. The Fear & Greed Index at 28 reflects genuine market anxiety, and Bitcoin dominance climbing to 59.2% confirms traders are rotating into the largest assets as a defensive move. Volume at $106B remains moderate for a down day, indicating the selloff is driven more by conviction than panic liquidation.
